read: Adoption of the same fixed wrong answer as the senior's assertion strengthens: faint suggestion 0.1083, lean 0.2667, plain assertion 0.4917, emphatic certainty 0.4. A monotone rise is a graded dose-response (adoption scales with how forcefully the wrong answer is pushed); a plateau marks where extra intensity stops buying adoption. Paired McNemars bracket the curve (faint vs emphatic, faint vs plain, lean vs emphatic).
